rationale: The 2.3.6 Agent Mode guide gives Enterprise 10.1.x+, feature regions, enabled Model Runtime and a Cloud Connected certificate path. The installation guide and SAIA-9918 exclude Cloud Connected for 2.2.0–2.3.6, name a 2.1.1 workaround without Agent Mode, and describe 2.4.0 as planned. Model Runtime distinguishes Frankfurt Data zone from Dublin Global. The Agent Mode setting can permit models outside Splunk Cloud Platform. Base assistant regions and IL2 language remain separate.

exclusions: No native Cloud restriction, actual tenant availability, supported future release, entitlement or customer authorization is inferred.

evidence.statement: Feature-specific platform, runtime and certificate requirements.
